create_HammerEnvV0: create a HammerEnvV0 MuJoCo environment instance for hammering nail tasks
run_HammerEnvV0_step: run the HammerEnvV0 step method to advance simulation with an action and return observation, reward, done flag, and env info
get_HammerEnvV0_obs: get the observation vector from HammerEnvV0 containing hand joints, object pose, tool position, and nail impact data
get_HammerEnvV0_reward_dict: get the reward dictionary from HammerEnvV0 with dense and sparse rewards based on palm-object distance, tool-target alignment, and nail insertion progress
evaluate_HammerEnvV0_success: evaluate the success rate of HammerEnvV0 rollout paths by counting episodes where the nail was driven in for more than 5 steps
